brand.name: FlexiTap POS
taglines: Enterprise reliability with modern, joyful simplicity
Train staff in 5 minutes. 100% offline resilience.
Bring your own hardware. Zero vendor lock-in.

modules_and_screens.name: Master Counter Terminal
modules_and_screens.details: Rings orders up in milliseconds with quick-category tabs, sub-second SKU matching, seat/guest tracking, and check holding. Cashiers can suspend transactions, process discounts, or split bills with zero lag.
modules_and_screens.best_for: Quick-service counters, fast-casual restaurants, food trucks

modules_and_screens.name: Customer-Facing Display (CDS)
modules_and_screens.details: Turns any secondary tablet, touch monitor, or compact screen toward the customer. Streams active cart items, taxes, totals, and frictionless QR loyalty sign-up codes over private local LAN.

modules_and_screens.name: Dedicated Kitchen Display System (KDS)
modules_and_screens.details: Replaces paper clutter and lost kitchen receipts with clean digital prep screens. Incoming tickets route automatically by station (Hot Bar, Cold Prep, Drinks) with visual completion cues.
modules_and_screens.best_for: Busy kitchens, multi-station restaurants, burger joints

modules_and_screens.name: Live Order Status Display (OSD)
modules_and_screens.details: Eliminates crowded pickup counters and shouted ticket numbers. Mount any TV or tablet in your lobby to show orders moving from '⏳ Preparing' to '✓ Now Serving' the instant kitchen bumps a ticket on KDS.
modules_and_screens.best_for: Food trucks, high-volume lunch counters, boba and coffee shops

modules_and_screens.name: Dynamic Digital Menu Boards (DMB)
modules_and_screens.details: Mount any TV, HDMI display, or smart screen overhead. Broadcast live menu categories, real-time pricing, and promotional tickers directly over LAN—eliminating expensive third-party menu board SaaS subscriptions.
modules_and_screens.best_for: Cafes, bakeries, food trucks, quick-service eateries

modules_and_screens.name: Executive Back Office Reports Hub
modules_and_screens.details: Comprehensive revenue trend curves, product category mix distributions, hourly rush volume, and verified cash & card balance audits. Automatic settlement matching and liability tracking.

modules_and_screens.name: Retail & Merchandise Mode
modules_and_screens.details: Designed for apparel boutiques and retail shops. Instant barcode lookup, real-time stock levels on every item tile, cart parking, and loyalty lookup.
modules_and_screens.best_for: Retail boutiques, convenience stores, merchandise pop-ups

modules_and_screens.name: Salon, Spa & Appointment Services
modules_and_screens.details: Manages appointment timelines, booking statuses (In-Progress, Confirmed, Scheduled), private treatment suites, and automatically calculates therapist commissions right on checkout tickets.
modules_and_screens.best_for: Barbershops, nail salons, massage spas, wellness centers

modules_and_screens.name: Visual Table Floor Plans & Dining Mode
modules_and_screens.details: Drag-and-drop table layouts, real-time table statuses, seat-based course ordering, and table-side guest ordering from roaming tablets.
modules_and_screens.best_for: Full-service dining, bistros, gastropubs, sports bars

modules_and_screens.name: Ask Flexi - Offline AI Business Analyst
modules_and_screens.details: Ask operational questions like 'What was our best-selling item during lunch rush?' or 'What are my top gross-margin items today?' completely offline with zero cloud lag.
modules_and_screens.best_for: Founders VIP Pass operators wanting actionable intelligence
